chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Isma'il ibn Marar from Yunus from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
It is not fitting for a Muslim to marry a Jewish woman or a Christian woman while he finds a free Muslim woman or a slave Muslim woman.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a Muslim man to marry a Jewish or Christian woman if a Muslim woman is available?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the ruling on marrying women of the Book, emphasizing the preference for Muslim women when available. It highlights the scholarly debate on whether 'yanbaghi' indicates strong recommendation (istihbab) or conditional obligation (wujub), reflecting the broader Shia jurisprudence on interfaith marriage. The mention of both free and slave women underscores the universality of this ruling across social statuses.
